name: Is it better to paint kitchen cabinets or replace them?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to paint kitchen cabinets or replace them?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional kitchen cabinet painting is significantly less expensive than replacing cabinets, often costing roughly one-third to one-half the price of brand-new units. While replacement requires ordering new boxes, demoing old cabinetry, and dealing with plumbing or countertop disruptions, painting keeps your existing layout intact and updates the look with far less turnaround time. The tradeoff is structural: painting cannot fix bowed shelving, deteriorated particle board, or poor kitchen workflow. If your cabinet boxes are structurally sound, painting delivers an updated aesthetic without the expense and downtime of a gut remodel.
acceptedAnswer.description: Painting is far faster and costs a fraction of replacement, making it ideal if your cabinet boxes are structurally sound and your kitchen layout works well for you.
